about.headerTitle: Eyakubiddwa Bannakenya, eri abakulembeze ba Kenya
about.storyP1: Kampaka za Kenya leero zikozesebwa ku ndowooza n'okubuuziganya okuva mu bakuguzi.
about.storyP2: Abawangula n'abaawangulwa batera okusalawo ku bwesimbu, so si mu kutegeera.
about.storyP4: Tuzimba enkola gye buli kusalawo kw'eby'obufuzi kutegekebwa mu kunoonyereza okutali kumu.
about.why1: Obukugu bw'omu kiseera ekituufu  tebufulumirirwa mu bakozi b'obukodyo
about.why3: Obuyambi obutayosa okuva mu kampeyini ng'oyita ku bufuzi
about.visionText: Abakulembeze basalawo okusinziira ku magezi, so si kusigama ku mukisa.
about.p1Desc: Yakolebwa mu Liswahili ne Sheng okuva ku lunaku olwasooka. Si za malwaliro z'omungereza ezikoleddwa nomu buvanjuba bwa Afirika
about.p2Desc: Ebyafaayo by'abalonzi tebinnagabanyizibwa. Buli kaweefube alaba bulumbaganyi bwe bwokka.
about.p3Desc: Ebisale byategekeddwa nti omuntu bw'alondako MCA omulundi ogusooka asobola okufuna ebikozesebwa bye bimu ngokulonda kwa gavana.
about.p4Desc: Twamwegendereza nnyo singa togera ku kutegeera kwomuntu omu okutegeerekeka okusinga okw'abantu kkumi abawungaana.

bios.morris: Okukulemberamu okulaba n'okukulaakulana kwa Kampeni. Okuzimba ekitongole ekisooka mu Kenya ekyebyamawulire okukyusa engeri abakulembeze gye basalawo.
bios.barak: Okuzimba enkola z'ebyokulonda ezifuula emikutu gy'empuliziganya egitali gimu egy'omu Kenya okuba ebyongerevu. Emabegako baazimba entendekero ezikwata ku byamawulire mu East Africa fintechs.
bios.albert: Okuteekawo enkola yokuzimba ebyuma - okuva ku bifo ebikujjuddemu obubaka n'omuyungo gwa NLP okutuuka ku dashboard kampeyini gye kwesigamaamu buli mambia.
bios.john: Okulabirira enkola ya Kampeni ey'ebyensimbi nokukakasa nti enteekateeka y'empuliziganya ekolebwamu mu byobufuzi bya Kenya.
bios.anwar: Okukulembera enkola y'ebyobufuzi nenkolagana ne basuubuzi mu Kenya yonna. Okuggyawo obwavu wakati w'obubaka bw'ebyamawulire n'okusalawo kw'okulonda kwa ddala

contact.eaDesc: Beera omu ku bakulembeze b'eby'obufuzi abaasooka mu Kenya okufuna enkola ya Kampeni. Ebifo ebitasobose bisobola kusasulibwa.
contact.partnerDesc: Ebibiina ebitawagira gavumenti, kampuni z'ebyokulonda n'amawulire  ka tulabe kye tuyinza okuzimba wamu.

features.headerSubtitle: Ebikozesebwa ebikessi bina nga bikolera wamu - n'olwekyo kampeyini yo bulijjo esobola okubaamu obubaka obusinga bwomuntu omulala yenna mu kisenge.
features.ctaSubtitle: Musabe okuyingira ku mulundi ogusooka oba okunoonyereza mu mpapula z'ebyamawulire.
features.f1Title: Ebikwata ku balonzi mu kiseera ekituufu
features.f1Sub: Manya ebyo abalonzi bammwe bye baagala bwe biba nga bigenda mu maaso
features.f1b1: Okulondoola enneewulira ku mikutu gy'empuliziganya, amawulire nobubaka obwa mu bifo
features.f1b2: Manya ensonga eziriwo nga tezinnafuuka buzibu
features.f1b3: Ssa essira ku bintu ebituusa ddala abalonzi bye baagala
features.f2Sub: Beera mu maaso ku buli kintu omulabe ky'akola
features.f2b1: Okulondoola ebigambo byonna ebyogerwa mu lujjudde n'ebyo ebifulumwamu ku mawulire
features.f2b2: Okuzuula obuzibu n'obutaba na bulongoofu mu kuweereza obubaka
features.f2b3: Okuteekawo enkola ezirimu obukakafu mu ddakiika ntono
features.f3Sub: Wa w'oyinza okusula ssente ezisinga ku zisale
features.f3b2: Okukungaanagana n'okukulaakulanya ssente ezikozesebwa mu kwekozesa ebyamalala
features.f3b3: Okukola enteekateeka y'okukozesa abakola ku byetaago
features.f4Sub: Gamba n'obwesige era olina okuteekateeka okuddamu okulondawo ku mulundi ogusooka
features.f4b2: Okulondoola ensonga ezikwata ku bantu nga bakozesa WhatsApp ne SMS
features.f4b3: Funa okulabula ku kukendeerawo kw'okukkiriza n'obulabe bw'eby'obufuzi

media.headerSubtitle: Byonna bannamawulire n'abakola ku mawulire bye beetaaga okukuba Kampeni.

media.r2Desc: Ebifaananyi eby'oku ntikko nokukuba ebifo mu kibinja ky'abakubi b'amawulire.
media.r3Desc: Omwogezi w'ekitongole, ebyogera ku bibala nobulagirizi bw'ekika.
media.quote: "Ekiseera ky'ebyobufuzi mu Kenya kirina abaakulembeze abakola okusalawo nga basinziira ku bubaka, so si kusosola."
